13:30.race_name: Alfriston Hotel - Have You Visited? Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Modest Flat maiden who has shown little in two starts over hurdles.
runners.name: Hialeah
runners.spotlight: Modest Flat maiden who has shown little in two starts over hurdles, pulling up latest over 2m4f here (soft) in January.

runners.comment: Three-time Flat winner who has been well held on both starts over hurdles.
runners.name: Major Major
runners.spotlight: Three-time Flat winner; well held on both starts over hurdles (2m) and will likely be of more interest when qualified for a mark.

runners.comment: Has shown some very useful form over hurdles and he's difficult to oppose.
runners.name: Mondo Man
runners.spotlight: Useful Flat racer; 0-5 over hurdles, but he was highly tried last season and encountered some useful opposition; ran a cracker on handicap debut when fourth in a hot Ascot contest in December (1m7f, good to soft); that effort sets a lofty standard and he should be hard to beat now in maiden company.

runners.breeder: Haras De S A Aga Khan Scea
runners.comment: He's struggled over hurdles; has had wind surgery since pulling up at Lingfield latest.
runners.name: Somkiyr
runners.spotlight: Fair Flat performer in France but he's struggled at big prices in three hurdle runs (2m) for new yard this winter, pulled up latest with a hood added; has since undergone wind surgery .

runners.comment: Initial efforts over hurdles read very well but he's been disappointing since.
runners.name: Thistle Be The One
runners.spotlight: Initial form over hurdles reads very well, having been beaten just 7.5l by the high-class Alexei and 3.5l by the useful French Ship; however, subsequent efforts have been disappointing by comparison, and was pulled up at Wincanton (1m7f) latest tried in cheekpieces (removed today); tongue-tie now added back into maiden company.

runners.comment: Beaten 43l on hurdle debut in France and probably best watched on British/stable debut.
runners.name: Lady Iris
runners.spotlight: Fourth foal; dam French 2m1f/2m2f hurdle/chase winner and a half sister to three winners; likeable pedigree but beaten 43l in a conditions hurdle at Angers (2m3f, soft) in September; best watched on stable/British debut.

runners.comment: Pulled up and well beaten on all three runs over hurdles, all at three-digit odds.
runners.name: My Lovely Horse
runners.spotlight: Pulled up and well beaten on all three runs over hurdles, all at three-digit odds; hard to make a case for.

runners.comment: 0-14 under both codes and he needs improvement on handicap hurdle debut
runners.name: Dr Waksman
runners.spotlight: 14-race maiden; went close on the Flat at Kempton (1m3f, AW) last July, but he's struggled under both codes in four subsequent runs; now makes his handicap hurdle debut but he needs improvement back in this sphere.

runners.comment: Unexposed 5yo but he was pulled up on handicap debut at Lingield (2m3f, soft) last month
runners.name: Blue Sky Dreaming
runners.spotlight: Unexposed 5yo who was a promising fourth in Ludlow maiden (2m, good) in November but he was pulled up on handicap debut at Lingfield (2m3f, soft; 9-1) last month; may have had stamina issues over that trip but he needs to bounce back on this return to 2m.

runners.comment: Bumper winner but he's 0-5 over hurdles and was disappointing at Fontwell last month
runners.name: Kool Kid
runners.spotlight: Won his sole bumper but he's 0-5 over hurdles; ran creditably when a 3l third on handicap debut here (2m4f, good to soft) in December but he was disappointing at Fontwell (2m3f, soft) last month; has a bit to prove after that and not sure this drop back in trip is ideal.

runners.breeder: G Hedley & Mike Channon Bloodstock Ltd
runners.comment: Close second in C&D novice in December but he struggled here latest and record is now 0-12
runners.name: Reteti
runners.spotlight: Came from the rear when close second in C&D novice (good to soft) in December but he struggled on his return visit two weeks ago; still unexposed over hurdles and now switches to a handicap but overall record is 0-12 and others are more convincing.

runners.breeder: Yeomanstown Ls Ltd T Coyle Flaxmanstable
runners.comment: Back to form with a game win at Market Rasen and a 3lb rise looks fair enough; key player
runners.name: Kalkaroo
runners.spotlight: Returned to form on his third run after a lengthy absence when scoring at Market Rasen (2m, soft) 22 days ago; back up 3lb for that narrow success but he showed a good attitude to justify favouritism and is now 2-6 over hurdles; key player.

runners.comment: Won at Doncaster on penultimate run and he needs a close look on handicap hurdle debut
runners.name: Dissident
runners.owner: Ben Haynes And Mrs Samantha Dunn
runners.spotlight: Blinkered the last twice, scoring gamely at Doncaster (2m, good to soft) then going too freely in a stronger juvenile hurdle at Kempton; needs to step up again after that last run but he still has potential and this is more realistic on handicap hurdle debut; first-time cheekpieces replace blinkers.

runners.comment: Mixed results in three hurdle runs and was last of seven on handicap debut over C&D latest
runners.name: Frank Stamper
runners.spotlight: Consistent on AW for previous stable but mixed results in three hurdle runs for current yard; 13-8 favourite on handicap debut over C&D (soft) last month but he never got involved before finishing last of seven; wasn't beaten far in that tactical race but he needs to resume his progress to make a big impact here.

14:35.race_name: Johnnie Boden Backs Jamie's Farm Amateur Jockeys' Handicap Chase (The Gay Kindersley Trophy) (GBB)

runners.comment: Hit clear personal best when winning over C&D latest and he's still unexposed at this trip
runners.name: Lumi Plugin
runners.owner: J Hinds A Head & G L Moore
runners.spotlight: Won over hurdles here (2m4f, good) last spring and he made it third time lucky over fences when landing a C&D handicap (soft) last month; up 5lb but he hit a clear personal with that comfortable win and he's still unexposed at this trip; strong contender.

runners.comment: Well held last twice but was an easy winner off only 1lb higher at Fakenham in December
runners.name: Enjoy dAllen
runners.spotlight: Versatile 12yo who was an easy winner at Fakenham (3m5f, soft) in December, but he's been well held at Windsor (3m4f) and Chepstow (2m7f) since; bit to prove again but he's only 1lb higher than for that last success and he could enjoy an easy lead in this small field.

runners.breeder: A Domenjoud & Haras De Saint Voir
runners.comment: Mudlover who was a creditable third behind Lumi Plugin over C&D last time; respected
runners.name: Georges Saint
runners.spotlight: Mudlover who has won four times over fences and he's run creditably at Warwick (3m, good to soft) and over C&D (soft) in last two starts; finished behind Lumi Plugin last time but he should give it another good shot and any rain would be a bonus.

runners.comment: Triple chase winner but he was pulled up last time and needs to bounce back near best
runners.name: Morfee
runners.spotlight: Won at Fontwell (3m2f, good) last June and is also effective on soft ground; returned from break with encouraging third of five over C&D (good to soft) in December, but he's not easy to predict and was pulled up at Windsor (3m4f) last time; now drops back in trip but he needs to bounce back near best.

15:15.race_name: Howden Rural Insurance Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners.comment: All four wins have been at Plumpton and he was a close second over C&D latest; respected
runners.name: Alto Alto
runners.spotlight: All of his five wins have come at Plumpton including three over C&D; tailed off in first two runs this season but he got back on track with a close second over C&D (soft) two weeks ago; remains feasibly treated off only 1lb higher and he should make another bold bid.

runners.comment: On a dangerous mark but he's been pulled up in two of his last three runs; risks attached
runners.name: Godot
runners.owner: A Lewers D Shaw A Irvine
runners.spotlight: On a dangerous mark and was runner-up at Lingfield (2m3f, soft) last month but that has been sandwiched by two pulled-up efforts; still unexposed over fences but he comes with risks attached and all of his wins have been at longer trips.

runners.breeder: E A R L De Faydeau
runners.comment: Made an encouraging start over fences when fourth of six over C&D last month; in the mix
runners.name: Known Warrior
runners.spotlight: Yet to be placed from six runs under rules but he made an encouraging start over fences when fourth of six in a C&D handicap (soft; first run after wind surgery) last month; was only beaten around 6l in that race and has possibilities if he can build on that.

runners.comment: Flat/hurdles winner who was a fair third in a C&D handicap last month; dangerous
runners.name: Sanitiser
runners.spotlight: Flat/hurdles winner who has posted consistent results (443) since switched to fences in November; ties in closely with Known Warrior on his C&D form last month and he should have more to offer in this sphere; dangerous.

runners.comment: Improved form after wind surgery with emphatic 2m win in the mud at Leicester; key player
runners.name: Kitsilano
runners.spotlight: Point/hurdle winner in Ireland and he made the breakthrough over regulation fences when scoring by 8l at Leicester (2m, heavy) 11 days ago; that was an improved effort after wind surgery and going back up 7lb looks fair enough; key player.

15:45.race_name: Jolly Sportsman Supports Jamie's Farm Novices' Limited Handicap Hurdle

runners.breeder: Haras Du Hoguenet & Mr Gilles Lebaron
runners.comment: Best run of the season over C&D two weeks ago on first try at this far; contender.
runners.name: Ami Bondhu
runners.spotlight: 0-9 over hurdles but ran his best race this season with cheekpieces added when an 11l third of six over C&D two weeks ago on his first try at this far; should be thereabouts if repeating the effort.

runners.comment: Can be forgiven latest run when the ground went against him; player on previous efforts.
runners.name: Glengolly
runners.spotlight: Broke his duck in good style at Hereford (3m2f, soft) in December, fitted with a tongue-tie, and backed that up with another solid effort behind a big improver at Uttoxeter; can be forgiven recent Ffos Las run where the ground went against him and he's worth considering.

runners.comment: Not yet fully exposed and reverts to hurdles off what may prove to be a workable mark.
runners.name: Minella Kaiser
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced maiden over hurdles who has showed improved form since switched to fences on last two starts; not yet fully exposed and reverts to hurdles off what may prove to be a workable mark.

runners.comment: Makes stable debut returning from a long absence and probably best watched.
runners.name: Amalfi Skyline
runners.spotlight: 2m5f chase winner and has the better form in that discipline, but he's not yet fully exposed over hurdles and his 7l second over C&D in May 2024 was a fair effort on final start for Pat Murphy; makes stable debut returning from a long absence and probably best watched.

runners.comment: Eight Flat wins but yet to make an impact over hurdles and others make more appeal.
runners.name: Smith
runners.spotlight: Eight-time Flat winner (1m2f-2m) who has yet to make a similar impact over hurdles and hasn't been seen in this sphere since pulling up over 2m4f here last April; others make more obvious appeal.

runners.breeder: E A R L Ecurie Des Mottes
runners.comment: Has to defy a 7lb higher mark but he's open to further progress and boasts strong claims.
runners.name: Junior Des Mottes
runners.spotlight: Appreciated the better ground and returning cheekpieces when winning at Fakenham (2m7f, soft) ten days ago; raised 7lb but it's unlikely he's reached his ceiling yet and he boasts strong claims in his follow-up bid.

runners.comment: Form has slumped since an encouraging return and step up in trip needs to spark a revival.
runners.name: The Last Drop
runners.spotlight: Form has slumped back up in trip on both runs since an encouraging return at Uttoxeter (2m, good to soft) in October; needs the step up to 3m to spark a revival.

runners.comment: Tailed off on two hurdle starts late last year and now goes up in trip.
runners.name: Engaging Sam
runners.spotlight: Suffered two heavy defeats since returning from a break late last year and hopes pinned on this longer trip bringing about some marked improvement.

runners.comment: Six-race maiden who likely needs more for that first success from out of the weights.
runners.name: Court One
runners.spotlight: Six-race maiden hurdler who has reached the frame on his last three runs since switched to handicaps, albeit beaten 31l at Lingfield (2m3f, soft) latest; from out of the weights he needs something extra for a first success today but he has place claims.

16:15.race_name: Sky Sports Racing Supports Jamie's Farm Handicap Chase

runners.comment: Running a big race before falling latest and likely to play a role if none the worse.
runners.name: Koenigsstern
runners.spotlight: Rather in and out since winning at Fontwell in December 2024, but he was in the process of running one of his better races when falling at the second last at Lingfield (2m4f, heavy) 18 days ago; likely to play a part if none the worse for that experience.

runners.breeder: S A R L Haras Du Berlais & Ballantines
runners.comment: Will appreciate this ease in class and she's capable of making her presence felt.
runners.name: Ostrava Du Berlais
runners.spotlight: Dual chase winner in December 2024 and fairly consistent since, but she has struggled back up in class on last two starts, albeit they were some tough assignments; should appreciate this ease in class and she's capable of making her presence felt.

runners.breeder: Ecurie Domaine De Baune Francois Thomas
runners.comment: Comes back in trip and worth considering, especially if the cheekpieces prove a positive.
runners.name: Le Galli Bier
runners.spotlight: Fair maiden over hurdles who, while still seeking his first win over fences, has shown enough to suggest a race of this nature is within his compass; comes back in trip and worth considering, especially if the cheekpieces have the desired effect.

runners.comment: Likely to be on slower ground today but this thriving 8yo is still the one to beat.
runners.name: Getaway King
runners.spotlight: Showed little in Ireland but has thrived since joining this stable, winning under Tom Broughton on all three starts (2m4f/2m5f), on ground no worse than good to soft; more needed off 4lb higher and the ground is likely to be on the soft side, but still the one to beat.

runners.comment: Needs to find considerable improvement for the switch to fences on handicap debut.
runners.name: Rap Soul
runners.spotlight: Runner-up on Irish point debut but disappointing under rules since, including over hurdles on his last three starts last year (2m-2m3f); could improve on switch to fences for handicap debut after a break, though will need to see it.

16:45.race_name: oldgoldracing.com Supports Jamie's Farm Mares' Handicap Hurdle

runners.comment: Big player despite the drop in trip and 3lb rise after last month's handicap debut win.
runners.name: Kilworth
runners.spotlight: Showed improved form and a willing attitude to get off the mark over hurdles on handicap debut at Taunton (good to soft) last month, keeping on stoutly over 3m; 3lb rise looks manageable, but the drop back to 2m4f is a slight concern as she appeared to need every yard of the longer trip; leading player all the same with Harry Cobden back in the saddle.

runners.comment: Merits respect now back up in trip after getting collared late over 2m here last time.
runners.name: A Tickatickatiming
runners.spotlight: Bumper and 2m hurdle (good to soft) winner here in 2023 and, although winless since in limited appearances, has posted some solid placed efforts, most recently when collared late over 2m here a fortnight ago; goes back up in trip and likely to be involved again.

runners.comment: Returned to form when second at Windsor last time and has claims if repeating that effort.
runners.name: Miss Kassiopi
runners.spotlight: A 13-race maiden who returned to something like her best with the addition of a tongue-tie when a 13l second at Windsor (2m4f, good to soft) in November; absent since and the tongue-tie is left off but has claims if reproducing that effort off an unchanged mark.

runners.comment: Ran her best race yet over hurdles when third last June but she's been absent since.
runners.name: My Louise
runners.spotlight: Dual bumper winner (first two starts) who had struggled to match that level over hurdles until a close third of nine at Newton Abbot (3m2f, good) last June, following wind surgery and fitted with a tongue-tie (retained); that was more like it, but she'll need to back that up returning from a 264-day break and down in trip.

runners.comment: Longer trip may eke out some improvement but others appeal more for win purposes.
runners.name: Suzy Wood
runners.spotlight: Six-race maiden who showed her first piece of worthwhile form when a close fifth over 2m here on last month's handicap debut; this longer trip may eke out a bit more, but others appeal more for win purposes.

runners.comment: Still early days and may do better in time but has enough to prove for now.
runners.name: Mild Magic
runners.spotlight: Irish point runner-up who has achieved little in four runs over hurdles, most recently when finishing a remote fourth at around this trip on last month's handicap debut; still early days and may do better in time, but she has enough to prove for now.

runners.comment: Solid effort over C&D last time and a repeat of that effort would see her go close.
runners.name: Eliza Dolittle
runners.spotlight: Dual C&D winner last season; bumped into a well-handicapped, subsequent winner when second over C&D last month; nudged up 2lb but a repeat of that effort would put her firmly in the picture.

runners.comment: Should be all the sharper for her comeback run but others hold more obvious claims.
runners.name: Little Lady Lucy
runners.spotlight: Unplaced all nine hurdle starts but has shown glimpses of ability; likely needed her return to action 21 days ago, so better can be expected, though others hold stronger claims.

13:50.race_name: Join Racing TV Now Handicap Chase (Go North Red Rum Series Qualifier) (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Beat 13 rivals to win at Carlisle and this lightly raced 8yo is a strong candidate up 6lb
runners.name: Orkney Blue
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 8yo who showed improved form on his third chase start to win at Carlisle (3m, good to soft) recently; also effective on soft/heavy; accounted for 13 rivals last time and he's a strong candidate up 6lb.

runners.comment: Stamina to prove but signs of promise at Carlisle last time and she's not ruled out
runners.name: Sunset Hill
runners.spotlight: 0-6 over fences and it's questionable whether she stays this far; however, off this reduced mark she was in contention in second place when unseating six out at Carlisle three weeks ago in first-time cheekpieces (retained), and she could have a part to play if seeing out the trip.

runners.comment: Promising third on stable/chase debut here in November but two lesser runs have followed
runners.name: Visual Impact
runners.spotlight: Promising third on her stable and chase debut here (2m4f, soft) in November, when 5lb higher; however, two lesser runs have followed (3m, soft; C&D most recently) and she needs to raise her game.

runners.comment: Runner-up over fences on last two starts and this 6yo could have more to offer; chance
runners.name: Blakey Boy
runners.spotlight: Fell on chase debut in November and has run well to finish second over fences on both outings since (2m7f/3m2f, good to soft); bled from the nose and lost both front shoes last time; this 6yo could have more to offer and may well be in the mix if handling conditions; unproven on soft/heavy ground.

runners.comment: 0-15 since winning on debut in March 2023 but arrives in good heart and could be involved
runners.name: Rob Roy Macgregor
runners.spotlight: 0-15 since winning on debut in March 2023 but he arrives in good heart, finishing second over C&D (heavy) last month and 9l fourth of 14 to Orkney Blue at Carlisle (3m, good to soft) last time; could be involved.

runners.comment: Not devoid of promise over C&D last month but two lesser runs have followed elsewhere
runners.name: Whispering Dancer
runners.spotlight: Not devoid of promise when fifth from 15lb out of the handicap over C&D last month on second chase start; the return to Ayr could be a positive but lesser runs have followed at Catterick and Carlisle and he's 10lb wrong at the weights this afternoon; a major turnaround is needed.

14:25.race_name: Watch On Racing TV Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Promising 4th on debut in November; disappointing since but leading claims on initial run
runners.name: Crackling Fire
runners.spotlight: Encouraging fourth in good-quality Chepstow maiden (2m3f, good to soft) on debut in November; disappointing at Warwick (2m5f, good to soft) in December and Sean Bowen rides stablemate Zamek today, but he's a leading player if rediscovering his initial promise.

runners.comment: 3m point winner who kept on for third over 2m here last time; respected back up in trip
runners.name: Irish Champ
runners.spotlight: Won Irish maiden point (3m, yielding on soft) in November and has also shown promise on both hurdle starts, most recently keeping on for third here (2m, soft); the step back up in trip could be the right move; respected.

runners.comment: Promising second on hurdle debut here and had excuse at Carlisle latest; retains potential
runners.name: Stride On
runners.spotlight: Bumper winner (2m, good to soft) who kept on for a promising second on hurdle debut here (2m, soft) in November; well-beaten favourite at Carlisle (2m3f, soft) next time but he suffered a wound to his left-fore and he retains potential; could bounce back and play a major role.

runners.comment: Runner-up on last three starts, most recently h'cap debut; can give another good account
runners.name: The G Wizard
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in two maiden hurdles towards the end of last year (2m5f/2m4f, soft/good to soft) before occupying the same position on handicap debut at Musselburgh (2m4f, good to soft); vulnerable if bumping into anything useful but he can give another good account.

runners.comment: Useful in bumpers in 2023-24 season; pulled up on sole run since but not written off
runners.name: Union Avenue
runners.spotlight: Two bumpers wins in late 2023 (good to soft/soft) and mid-division in the Champion Bumper later that season; then absent until December 2025, when pulled up on hurdle debut; however, he was sent off favourite and may have needed that outing; wears first-time cheekpieces; not written off.

runners.comment: Kept on for third of 18 over 2m at Lingfield and he's open to improvement now up in trip
runners.name: Zamek
runners.spotlight: He's raced four times and has shown promise on each occasion, most recently keeping on for 7l third of 18 in maiden hurdle at Lingfield (2m, soft); has since had wind op and wears first-time tongue-tie today; open to improvement now up in trip and he's Sean Bowen's mount of Olly Murphy's two runners.

15:00.race_name: Every Race Live On Racing TV Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Return to form needed from 12yo but this is the stage of the season he tends to come good
runners.name: Dubai Days
runners.spotlight: 12yo who hasn't been at the top of his game on either outing this term and was tailed off at Aintree most recently; however, this is the stage of the season when he tends to come good and he's 2lb lower than when scoring at Haydock last February; has won here four times, and on various ground.

runners.comment: Interesting contender now back up in trip on handicap debut and second chase start
runners.name: Big John Wayne
runners.spotlight: Far from disgraced when last of five on last month's chase debut here (2m, heavy), when 33-1 and very much up against it at the weights on his first outing since October 2024; this 3m point winner showed promise in novice hurdles at up to 2m7f; interesting now back up in trip on handicap debut.

runners.breeder: S Cozenot H Cozento & E Guetin
runners.comment: Maiden hurdle winner who goes straight over fences for his handicap debut; could go well
runners.name: Jaccours
runners.spotlight: Got off the mark at the seventh attempt in a maiden hurdle at Ffos Las (2m4f, heavy) last month; his respected trainer sends him straight over fences for his handicap debut and this unexposed 7yo could have a part to play.

runners.breeder: J C Haimet & A F Peter
runners.comment: The return to fences may help but he has lots to prove regarding current form
runners.name: One Mill Harbour
runners.spotlight: Goes back over fences for the first time since winning at Hexham (1m7f, heavy) in November 2023, one of three chase victories that year; however, he's been well below his best over hurdles on his two runs this winter, following a long absence, and has lots to prove regarding current form.

runners.comment: On a competitive season's on last season's chase form but that was over 2m
runners.name: Dance Thief
runners.spotlight: He's on a competitive mark on last season's 2m chase form here and reappeared with a respectable fifth over hurdles here in November; however, he's had another break since and it's possible a shorter trip is preferable.

runners.comment: Won in good style here last month and this progressive 7yo may take 6lb rise in his stride
runners.name: Tommy Combats
runners.spotlight: Runner-up over C&D in November and made it 2-8 over fences when winning in good style here (2m, soft) last month; this progressive 7yo may well take a 6lb rise in his stride.

runners.comment: Took step back in right direction here a fortnight ago but he needs another today
runners.name: Don Occhetti
runners.spotlight: Won easily for Dan Skelton at Worcester in August 2024; he's returned from a long absence for a new yard this year and, while his run here a fortnight ago was a step back in the right direction, he needs another today.

15:30.race_name: 100% RacingTV Profits Back To Racing Novices' Hurdle (Go North Night Nurse Hurdle Qualifier) (GBB)

runners.comment: Sprung 125-1 shock at Down Royal last month and leading claims if confirming that promise
runners.name: Green Hope
runners.spotlight: Fourth in two points and held when unseating at last flight on hurdle debut in December, but sprung 125-1 shock in maiden hurdle at Down Royal (2m1f, yielding to soft) last month; leading claims if confirming that promise.

runners.comment: Won at Southwell then runner-up here, and he holds strong claims
runners.name: Next Twist
runners.spotlight: Won by 6l in first-time hood (retained since) at Southwell (2m, good to soft) in November on second hurdle start, and good second here since (2m, heavy) under a penalty; strong claims today.

runners.breeder: S C E A Ste Ent Etienne Et Gregoire Lee
runners.comment: Has shown ability but work to do to threaten the two previous winners
runners.name: Linalene
runners.spotlight: In good hands and has shown ability; a bad mistake proved costly at Kelso last time but he has work to do to threaten the two previous winners.

runners.comment: Runner-up in bumper on debut but pulled up at big odds on both hurdle starts
runners.name: Luckie Devil
runners.spotlight: Runner-up on debut in bumper at Newcastle last March but disappointing since and pulled up at big odds on both hurdle starts.

runners.comment: Didn't show enough in bumpers to suggest she'll be making an impact today
runners.name: Ms Cindy Kate
runners.spotlight: Fairly encouraging run when fifth of 14 on debut in bumper at Uttoxeter (2m, good) last July, but down the field at Perth (2m, good) in August; dramatic improvement is needed now going over hurdles after a break.

16:00.race_name: Join Racing TV Now Handicap Hurdle (Go North Cab On Target Series Qualifier)

runners.comment: Won with something to spare over C&D last month and holds strong claims up 7lb
runners.name: Diamond Geezer
runners.spotlight: Won in first-time cheekpieces (retained since) at Perth (2m4f, soft) in October and returned to winning ways over this C&D (soft) last month; had 6l to spare from Eloi Du Puy last time and holds strong claims up 7lb.

runners.comment: Ran okay last time and drops in grade today off a reduced mark; could have a part to play
runners.name: Jericoacoara
runners.owner: G R Orchard & Mrs J M Gray
runners.spotlight: His French win came in 2023 and he's 0-5 in Britain; however, he ran okay when fifth of nine at Wetherby (2m5f, soft) last time and drops in grade today off a reduced mark; could have a part to play.

runners.breeder: S C E A Haras Du Puy
runners.comment: Third in this last year and 6l second over C&D last month; could be thereabouts
runners.name: Eloi Du Puy
runners.spotlight: Third in this last year (heavy) and achieved his best result of this season when 6l second to Diamond Geezer in first-time cheekpieces (retained) over C&D (soft) last month; could be thereabouts.

runners.comment: Went close on last hurdle start & hasn't taken to fences subsequently; returns to hurdles
runners.name: Mountain Molly
runners.spotlight: Point/novice hurdle winner who wasn't beaten far into second behind Diamond Geezer on handicap hurdle debut at Perth (2m4f, soft) in October; hasn't taken to fences subsequently and she could play a leading role now back hurdling.

runners.comment: 11yo who won three times last August-October but tailed off in November when last seen
runners.name: The Navigator
runners.spotlight: 11yo who won three times last August-October (2m1f/2m5f, good); however, tailed off at Kelso (2m5f, good to soft) in November when last seen and there's a suspicion he may not want testing ground nowadays.

runners.breeder: E A R L Haras Du Luy
runners.comment: Runner-up on h'cap debut last January; absent since but bang there if at top of his game
runners.name: Balking
runners.spotlight: Very lightly raced 8yo who had wind surgery prior to his handicap debut last January and finished second of 16 at Wetherby (2m3f, soft; 25-1); absent since but he'll be bang there if resuming where he left off.

runners.comment: Running well in defeat in the main this season and can give another good account
runners.name: El Jefe
runners.spotlight: He's been running well in defeat in the main this season, finishing a close fourth at Kelso (2m6f, heavy) ten days ago when upped in trip; he should be fine now back down in distance and can give another good account.

runners.comment: Back on track with close second of six at Sedgefield and she could be in the mix
runners.name: Nellie Bluesky
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced since 50-1 win on hurdle debut at Perth (2m4f, good to soft) in May 2024, and she got back on track with close second of six at Sedgefield (2m4f, good to soft) last month; could be in the mix if this slower ground isn't an issue.

runners.comment: He's achieved very little under rules but has won a point; watch the market on h'cap debut
runners.name: Go Frankie
runners.spotlight: Won a point-to-point in November 2024 on eighth start in that sphere; he's achieved very little under rules but has travelled from Ireland to make his handicap debut, for which cheekpieces are applied; watch the betting.

runners.comment: Last year's winner who returned to form when third over C&D a fortnight ago; contender
runners.name: The Jewellers Pet
runners.spotlight: Won this last year (heavy) and, following an unsuccessful stint over fences, he returned to form when back over hurdles and third over C&D (soft) a fortnight ago, when short of room turning for home; contender.

runners.breeder: J Blackburn S Winter & H Cram
runners.comment: Has potential off opening mark in view of juvenile hurdle form; tackles a new trip
runners.name: Lights Go Down
runners.spotlight: 0-9 on the Flat but he's shown promise on all three hurdle starts and has potential off his opening mark judged on his close second at Wetherby (2m, soft) in December; receives handy 4yo allowance and he could have a big part to play if seeing out this new trip.

16:30.race_name: Watch On Racing TV National Hunt Flat Race (Conditional & Amateur) (Category 1 Elimination) (GBB)

runners.comment: Won at Musselburgh then fifth at Newcastle; could settle better now in a hood; respected
runners.name: Kilaro
runners.spotlight: British point winner (2m4f, good) who followed up on bumper debut at Musselburgh (1m7f, good to soft) in December; soundly beaten fifth at Newcastle (2m1f, good to soft) since but could settle better now in a hood; respected.

runners.comment: Showed ability in a point but well beaten at 28-1 in his sole bumper
runners.name: CMon So
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in Irish maiden point (3m, good) last April on third start, but failed to threaten and was well beaten at 28-1 on bumper debut at Southwell (2m, good to soft) in December; improvement needed.

runners.comment: Bought for £220,000 after winning a point; could play a leading role on bumper debut
runners.name: Jardin De Tunis
runners.spotlight: Won Irish maiden point (3m, soft) in November on second start and sold for £220,000 later that month; he's joined a respected stable for his rules career and could play a leading role on bumper debut.

runners.comment: Placed over C&D on first two starts and he's in with a leading shout today
runners.name: Kingsman Mail
runners.spotlight: Half-brother to stable's very useful jumper Elvis Mail, among others; promising second on debut over C&D (soft) in November; failed to build on that when soundly beaten third over C&D (heavy) last month but he's still in with a leading shout today.

runners.breeder: S C E A Ecurie Haras De La Rousseliere
runners.comment: Bumped into classy sort when 11l second last March on sole start; firmly in calculations
runners.name: Lirion
runners.owner: Mrs Diana L Whateley McNeill & Stone Families
runners.spotlight: Beaten by the classy Mydaddypaddy when 11l second on debut at Huntingdon (2m, good to soft) last March; sold out of Tom Weston's yard for £60,000 later that month; absent since but still firmly in calculations on stable debut.

16:25.race_name: Midnite: Built For 2026 Not 2006 Apprentice Handicap

runners.comment: C&D win last week in a modest Class 5; down in grade but penalty/wide draw to deal with
runners.name: Woodhay Whisper
runners.spotlight: Held by Albert Cee and Neptune Legend on C&D efforts this winter and although she won well here last week, that wasn't a strong Class 5; could prove vulnerable from the widest stall under a penalty.

runners.comment: C&D win in December came off 1lb lower; not in quite the same form since
runners.name: Twilight Madness
runners.owner: P R Hedger & P C F Racing Ltd
runners.spotlight: Two front-running wins in December and only 1lb higher for the latter, which came over C&D; not quite so good since and others appeal more for win purposes.

runners.comment: Revived by wind surgery this winter; runs off same mark as when 2nd over C&D 17 days ago
runners.name: Albert Cee
runners.spotlight: Back to form after wind surgery, third at Southwell in December before a 6f win at that track last month; bumped into a well-handicapped opponent over C&D 17 days ago (Woodhay Whisper third and 3lb worse off); solid chance off an unchanged mark.

runners.comment: Well handicapped and return to 6f/drop to Class 6 can see her bounce back to form
runners.name: Bint Havana Gold
runners.owner: Alan & Christine Bright And John Henwood
runners.spotlight: 3lb lower than for her last win (6f at Chelmsford last October); she has found it tougher going since but the drop back into Class 6 company and return to 6f should prompt an improved showing.

runners.comment: Usually reliable but below par at Chelmsford on Saturday; remains a maiden after 20 starts
runners.name: Invincible Melody
runners.spotlight: Usually reliable and has finished second on eight of his 20 starts, including over 7f here two weeks ago when beaten a short head; however, he's yet to win and was below par at Chelmsford (6f) on Saturday.

runners.comment: Down in weights and returned to form on stable debut last September; well treated; claims
runners.name: Running Cool
runners.spotlight: Two turf wins (6f/5f) in Ireland in 2023; struggled for Tim Easterby but he had dropped a long way in the weights and returned to form when second of nine over 5f here in September (stable debut); still of interest from a handicapping perspective; high on the shortlist.

runners.breeder: Mr & Mrs S Matheson & Mr S Goodwin
runners.comment: Two sprint wins last spring, including here (5f); still low mileage; betting useful
runners.name: Trust Sergei
runners.spotlight: Two sprint wins last spring, including here (5f); not at his best when last in action but he brings low mileage and needs a look in the betting back from 135 days off.

runners.comment: Four course wins this winter; up in the weights but improving and may do better yet
runners.name: Midnight Call
runners.spotlight: 4-5 this winter, all the wins here (two over this trip); 9lb higher than for her last handicap start but could still have more to offer.

runners.comment: C&D win in November off 2lb higher; quiet lately but at 5f and in higher grade; can revive
runners.name: Neptune Legend
runners.spotlight: Beat Woodhay Whisper over C&D in November and 7lb better off with that rival today; quiet on his last three starts but there have been mitigating circumstances (5f; two of the runs in Class 5); things look in place for a more potent effort this time.

runners.comment: Not found best form for new yard, including in a 0-50 at Newcastle on Thursday
runners.name: Classy Clarets
runners.spotlight: Yet to find his best form for new stable, including when sixth of eight in a 0-50 classified event at Newcastle on Thursday; more needed back up in grade.

17:00.race_name: Always Gamble Responsibly At BetMGM Restricted Maiden Fillies' Stakes (Bands B, C & D) (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Shaped with promise on recent Chelmsford debut and she should know more this time
runners.name: Silver Splash
runners.owner: SBK Racing & B & J Parr Racing Ltd
runners.spotlight: Dam won four times in Argentina including two Group 2s on dirt; 40-1 on recent Chelmsford debut (6f) but she made some late headway and was only beaten around 3l in fourth of seven; that form isn't strong but she should know more this time and is a likely improver on her second start.

runners.comment: Went close over 6f in first of her three runs last summer; could be dangerous on return
runners.name: Angelas Baar
runners.spotlight: Market support but denied clear run when finishing well to go close at Pontefract (6f) last June; hasn't gone on from that in two runs since but the drop to 5f looked against her at Thirsk in August;  returns after 199 days off but she still has potential and could be dangerous back at 6f.

runners.comment: Runner-up at Kempton (7f) in her final run in the autumn and she's in the mix on return
runners.name: Calling A Star
runners.owner: A Smith J Henwood & Star Amusements
runners.spotlight: 0-5 but she's finished runner-up twice, including at Kempton (7f) on her final run last autumn; this is a deeper race but she's been generally progressive so far and should be unfazed by this drop back in trip; each-way claims back from from 170 days off.

runners.comment: Well-bred filly but she could be one for longer trips later on
runners.name: Enduring Story
runners.spotlight: First foal; dam once-raced half-sister to winners Biz The Nurse (Italian 1m4f Group 1), Biz Heart (Italian 1m 2yo Group 2) and Misterious Boy (Italian 1m1f 2yo Group 3), out of Italian 7.5f 2yo Listed winner; yard is in decent form but she could be one for longer trips later on.

runners.comment: Close second on Wetherby debut last June and sets the standard on that form; key player
runners.name: Lara Antipova
runners.owner: Moulton Racing And Mrs A Jordan
runners.spotlight: 42,000gns yearling; has plenty of speed in her pedigree and she made a promising start when close second at Wetherby (5.5f, good to firm) last June; has been absent since but she sets the standard on that debut form and is open to progress on this step up in trip; key player.

runners.comment: Made low-key start over C&D last month and she needs major improvement
runners.name: Safe Zone
runners.spotlight: 60,000euros yearling; attracted support into 11-2 on C&D debut last month but she got outpaced at a crucial stage before finishing fifth of six; should know more this time but she needs a major step forward to get involved.

runners.comment: Down the field in two runs in December and minor handicaps will be more suitable
runners.name: In Denial
runners.spotlight: Finished down the field at Kempton (6f) and Wolverhampton (5f; 66-1) in December; has lots to find back up in trip and minor handicaps will be more suitable.

runners.comment: Well held at big prices in two runs this year, the latest over C&D
runners.name: Nautical Sky
runners.spotlight: Well held at big prices in two runs this year and the latest was over C&D; remains best watched for now.

runners.comment: 33,000gns yearling; yard 24% in maidens last year and she needs a close look on debut
runners.name: Ring Of Diamonds
runners.spotlight: 18,000euros foal, 33,000gns yearling; first foal; dam French 7f/7.5f winner, half-sister to 8.5f Listed winner Up Helly Aa, out of 1m Group 1 winner; yard had 24% strike-rate in maidens last year and she needs a close look on debut.

runners.comment: Finished third in both runs last summer and she's respected back in trip on her return
runners.name: Tenzi
runners.spotlight: Close up on Goodwood debut (6f, good) last June and she finished third again when upped to 7.3f at Ffos Las (soft) later that month; her initial form puts her firmly in the picture and she shaped as though this drop back in trip would suit last time; respected on reappearance.

runners.comment: Big prices and she's been beaten around 12l in two runs this year, including over C&D
runners.name: Follow My Heart
runners.spotlight: Big prices and she's been beaten around 12l in two runs this year, including over C&D last time; passed over.

17:30.race_name: Daily Profit Boosts At betmgm.co.uk Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.comment: 100-1 and always behind in a Ludlow bumper last month; not easily recommended
runners.name: Oceanides
runners.spotlight: 100-1 and always behind in a Ludlow bumper last month; not easily recommended.

runners.comment: Two solid handicap runs for new yard this year; headgear returns; each-way claims again
runners.name: Summer Heat
runners.spotlight: Solid second-place finishes in Kempton fillies' handicaps for new yard this year (7f and 1m); cheekpieces return today; likely to give her running once again and her in-form apprentice rider takes off a handy 5lb.

runners.comment: Promising fifth at Newmarket (7f) last August; absent since but open to plenty of progress
runners.name: City Queen
runners.spotlight: 8-1 for Newmarket debut last August (7f, good to firm) when staying on nicely into fifth (solid form); open to plenty of improvement this year and she is bred to relish this longer trip; strong claims.

runners.comment: 105,000gns yearling; dam a well-related Group 2 winner; top yard; market to guide
runners.name: Itsonlyrockandroll
runners.spotlight: 105,000gns yearling; second foal of a 9.4f-12.5f winner (including 2yo/AW/Group 2; RPR 116), herself from a good family; represents a powerful stable and the betting should provide clues.

runners.comment: Didn't build on debut promise three weeks later; handicaps over further will suit better
runners.name: Kelly Burn
runners.spotlight: Clear promise on debut at Kempton in November but she took a backward step at Southwell three weeks later (both 1m); middle-distance handicaps likely to see her in a better light after this; hooded for the first time.

runners.comment: Has some useful winning siblings, notably Khaloosy (RPR 114); check the betting on debut
runners.name: Midnight Sparkle
runners.spotlight: Eighth foal; closely related to 8.6f AW 2yo/1m turf (Britannia Handicap) winner Khaloosy (RPR 114), half-sister to winners Moqtarreb (1m including Listed; 109) and Zaajel (7f AW 2yo; 76); dam unplaced 1m/1m2f (70), from family of Nathaniel; betting to guide.

runners.comment: Promise on debut but couldn't build on it at Newcastle recently; improvement a must here
runners.name: Pendella
runners.spotlight: Shaped well on her Southwell debut (7f) in December but she failed to progress when fourth at Newcastle (1m) 19 days ago; still has time to do better but others are more appealing.

runners.comment: Promise amidst inexperience on Newbury debut (7f); tongue tied for return; can do better
runners.name: Regatta
runners.spotlight: 25-1 when beaten just over 10l into seventh of ten in a Newbury fillies' maiden (7f, good to firm) in August; bred to do a fair bit better this year; tongue tied on return; yard in form.

runners.comment: £80,000 2yo; sister to Listed winner and half-sister to AW winner in France; check betting
runners.name: Silken Bay
runners.spotlight: £80,000 breeze-up 2yo; fifth foal; sister to 7f 2yo/11.4f Listed winner Cresta (RPR 113), half-sister to French 8.5f AW winner Nove Su Nove; dam unraced sister to 1m Listed winner Gabrial; enough paper appeal to warrant a look in the market.

18:00.race_name: Read Meg Nicholls' Blog At betmgm.co.uk Handicap (Div I)

runners.comment: Down in grade and suitable conditions but not sure he's in the form required to capitalise
runners.name: Romanovich
runners.owner: Mrs S M Maine & Roger Gould
runners.spotlight: Conditions no problem and this represents an ease in grade; not sure he's in quite the form required to capitalise though.

runners.comment: Not at best this winter but now eligible for 0-55 again; better could be forthcoming
runners.name: Amaysmont
runners.spotlight: Four wins in 2024, including C&D; not fired on all cylinders this winter but that has enabled him to run at this level for the first time since winning twice in 0-55s at Chelmsford in May 2024; revival could be imminent.

runners.comment: On losing run and has to prove stamina for 7f but latest effort (6f) not without hope
runners.name: Rambuso Creek
runners.spotlight: Both wins have come over 5f, the second of them back in October 2023; fair fourth at Southwell last month (6f) but stamina for 7f has to be taken on trust.

runners.comment: Hold-up handicapper; effective under the conditions; the faster the pace the better
runners.name: River Wharfe
runners.spotlight: Hold-up handicapper who gained third course win (tenth overall) when leading late over 8.6f in October; now 1lb below that mark and he has been placed on last two starts; likely to be dropped in so stall 10 not the negative it might be for some of these; chance if getting a good pace to run at.

runners.comment: Strong at the finish for a 6f win here two weeks ago; 2lb rise fine and no problem with 7f
runners.name: Ramon Di Loria
runners.spotlight: He was landing his tenth win when strong at the finish in a 6f handicap here two weeks ago; stays 7f and a 2lb rise isn't beyond him; solid contender.

runners.comment: C&D win in December and held his form since; should give it another good go
runners.name: Bad Habits
runners.spotlight: Off the mark at the 17th attempt when landing a C&D handicap over the Christmas period; several good efforts have followed and a mid-race stumble didn't help his cause here last week; in the mix once more.

runners.comment: C&D winner; arrives in good order and more appealing than many back up to 7f
runners.name: Porfin
runners.spotlight: C&D winner; won at Lingfield (6f) last month before finishing a close second at this track nine days later; respectable efforts since and he's one to take seriously now back up in distance.

runners.comment: Two C&D wins for new yard this winter, the latest 17 days ago; can't be discounted
runners.name: Von Krolock
runners.spotlight: Two C&D wins for this yard since November, the latest in a classified event 17 days ago; more on his plate back in a handicap but he can't be discounted for a trainer/jockey combination in good form.

runners.comment: She has run some fair races this winter; drops back in trip with Billy Loughnane booked
runners.name: Lhebayeb
runners.spotlight: She has run some creditable races in defeat for her new stable this winter but the drop back to 7f isn't sure to be in her favour; Billy Loughnane is a notable booking though.

runners.comment: Not matched best 2025 form in three runs this winter; full revival needed
runners.name: Buttercross Flyer
runners.spotlight: Won a classified race at Lingfield (7f, AW) last summer; short of her best in three runs this winter though and she needs a full revival.

runners.comment: Fair third over C&D 17 days ago on first run after wind/gelding ops; more needed today
runners.name: Legendsoftheland
runners.spotlight: 13-race maiden; fair third over C&D 17 days ago on first run after wind and gelding operations; now has something to build on but this looks a tougher task.

18:30.race_name: Read Meg Nicholls' Blog At betmgm.co.uk Handicap (Div II)

runners.comment: Course winner who scored over 7f at Chepstow last summer; in the mix on his return
runners.name: King Of The Dance
runners.spotlight: Dual AW winner who scored over 7f at Chepstow last July and was runner-up there on his penultimate run last year; returns after five months off but he still looks feasibly treated and he needs watching in market.

runners.name: Thomas Equinas
runners.spotlight: All five wins have come at Chelmsford, the latest back in October 2024; went close over C&D last September but he's been quiet in both runs this winter and needs to rediscover his spark; cheekpieces are removed and blinkers return.

runners.comment: Close third over C&D two weeks ago and she's a big player if she can back that up
runners.name: Believe In Lies
runners.spotlight: Won on handicap debut at Carlisle (7f, good to firm) last August; been up and down since but she bounced back with a close third over C&D two weeks ago; did clear best of the hold-up performers in that race and she's a big player if she can back that up.

runners.comment: Won over C&D and at Lingfield this winter; dead-heated for third at Chelmsford on Saturday
runners.name: Homme De Fer
runners.spotlight: Won over C&D and at Lingfield in December and held his form with placed efforts on Polytrack and Tapeta last month, while he again ran well when dead-heating for third at Chelmsford on Saturday; probably still has some room to manoeuvre off this mark and he has a good record under William Carson.

runners.comment: Her last win was in 2024 but was a clear second behind Faster Bee over C&D last Monday
runners.name: Nammos
runners.spotlight: Her last win was in October 2024 but she's on a reduced mark and was a clear second behind Faster Bee over C&D (first-time visor) last Monday; that was only her second run for James Owen and she's respected off 1lb lower.

runners.breeder: Mrs S Bunney & Mr P Taplin
runners.comment: On dangerous mark but she's 0-18 and has been out of sorts in both runs this winter
runners.name: Whiteley Way
runners.spotlight: Well handicapped on her best form last year but she's been out of sorts in both runs this winter and her overall record is now 0-18; down the list.

runners.comment: Runner-up here on penultimate run and is now 1lb lower than for last win; possibilities
runners.name: Fistral Beach
runners.spotlight: All three wins have been on Tapeta and latest was over C&D last April; has had some ups and down this winter but was runner-up here on her penultimate run and she's now 1lb lower than for that last win; not ruled out.

runners.comment: Off the mark with a dominant display over C&D last Monday; big player again under penalty
runners.name: Faster Bee
runners.spotlight: No win in his first 25 starts but he came good with a dominant display from wide draw over C&D last Monday; that was a surprise at 12-1 but he never looked in any serious danger and is only 4lb higher under a penalty; major player again.

runners.comment: 20-race maiden and she's faded in both runs for current yard; others preferred
runners.name: My Mate Beattie
runners.spotlight: Placed six times for Ed Dunlop but she's faded in both runs for current yard and latest was over C&D two weeks ago; record is now 0-20 and others are preferred.

runners.comment: 20-race maiden who was well held on her C&D reappearance 17 days ago; down the list
runners.name: Marisitta
runners.spotlight: 20-race maiden who was a well-held fourth on her C&D reappearance 17 days ago; should be sharper this time but she's hard to predict and others are more convincing; 1lb out of the weights.

19:00.race_name: Bet £10 Get £40 With BetMGM Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.comment: 66-1 for belated debut (1m) in January but hinted at minor ability; handicaps more likely
runners.name: Belltony
runners.spotlight: Friendless in the market before making belated debut over the extended 1m here in January and although finishing last of seven he hinted at minor ability; has more to prove at 7f though and handicaps are more likely.

runners.comment: Solid pedigree and yard in form but this is a delayed debut with a hood fitted
runners.name: Street Dancer

runners.comment: Soundly beaten in 2 runs for previous yard, at 7f and 1m; handicaps soon
runners.name: Baggie Boy
runners.spotlight: Soundly beaten in two starts for Jack Jones in midwinter, at 7f and 1m; more likely to find his feet in handicaps than a maiden.

runners.comment: Useful pedigree and betting moves need a close look on debut
runners.name: Crown Relic
runners.spotlight: First foal; by Kingman out of once-raced sister to smart Bravais, 7f/7.4f winner/placed in 1m4f French Group 2; closely related to French 10.5f winner At No Time; betting moves need a close look on debut.

runners.comment: Big prices and always behind in two novice events on turf and Newcastle AW as 2yo
runners.name: Palazzo Ducale
runners.spotlight: Big prices and never left the rear division in two novice events on turf and Newcastle AW as 2yo; gelded since but can only watch; yard also runs Baggie Boy.

runners.comment: 95,000gns yearling; useful pedigree but offputting that he's visored for debut
runners.name: Spangled Impact
runners.spotlight: 35,000gns foal; 95,000gns yearling; eleventh foal; half-brother to five winners up to 7f including Hit The Bid (5f including 2yo/AW Group 3; RPR 112) and Ruthin (US 5.5f including 2yo/Listed; 104); dam 6f-1m winner (including Listed/2yo; 105); smart pedigree but already visored which is offputting.

runners.comment: Triple-figure prices and well held over 1m and 7f this year; no case this time
runners.name: Warm Waters
runners.spotlight: Triple-figure prices for both starts this year (7f and 1m; hooded each time); heading for ordinary handicaps after this final qualifying run.

runners.comment: Promising 2yo at about 7f on turf for R Beckett; gelded; sights lowered on yard debut
runners.name: Waterford Castle
runners.spotlight: Took on useful prospects, showing promise, in three 2yo turf runs at about 7f for Ralph Beckett, including the Listed Chesham at Royal Ascot; gelded since last seen in August; type to do better as a 3yo and sights lowered on yard debut.

19:30.race_name: Midnite Are Upping The Betting Game Classified Stakes (Div I)

runners.comment: Has not been at best this winter and meets most of today's rivals on unfavourable terms
runners.name: Boujee Gold
runners.spotlight: Dual course winner (8.6f), but she's not been at her best this winter and was beaten 6l when third in a Southwell handicap last time; has something to prove and she meets most of today's rivals on unfavourable terms.

runners.comment: Record of 1-24 but he's effective over C&D and could be in the mix back up in trip
runners.name: Change Of Fortune
runners.spotlight: Record of 1-34 but his win was at Ffos Las last summer and he returned from a break with an encouraging fifth here (8.6f classified) last month; should benefit from that run and he could be dangerous back up in trip.

runners.name: Frontpagemoos

runners.name: Hijo De La Luna
runners.spotlight: Returned from a break with two placed efforts in classified events (1m3f/1m2f) last month, but his form nosedived at Newcastle last Sunday; has something to prove again after that major blip and he's now 0-29; first-time visor.

runners.comment: Seven-race maiden who has not finished closer than 5l to a winner and has a best RPR of 40
runners.name: Platinum Babe
runners.spotlight: Seven-race maiden who has not finished closer than 5l to a winner and has a best RPR of 40; opposable.

runners.comment: Record of 1-31 but she needs checking in market back from a break
runners.name: Regal Glory
runners.spotlight: Not easy to predict and has record of 1-31 but she's had only three starts for Roger Fell and went close at Leicester (1m2f) on her penultimate run; that form puts her in the picture and she needs watching in market on reappearance.

runners.comment: Ran a big race at a big price at Lingfield and has each-way claims if he can back that up
runners.name: Sun Festival
runners.spotlight: Winless since 2023 but he ran a big race at a big price when third in classified event at Lingfield (1m2f) last month; that was eyecatching from off the pace and he has each-way claims again if he can repeat that form.

20:00.race_name: Midnite Are Upping The Betting Game Classified Stakes (Div II)

runners.comment: Good fourth in classified event over C&D latest and ties in with Dash Power on that form
runners.name: Chourmo
runners.spotlight: Scored four times on turf in 2024; on the decline since and 0-13 on AW but he was well backed when a creditable fourth in a C&D classified event ten days ago when just behind Dash Power; big player if he can build on that.

runners.comment: Record of 1-40 but he's been in good form in classified events this year; respected
runners.name: Dash Power
runners.spotlight: Just one win from 40 starts but he's reached the frame in classified events in his last four runs including when third over C&D ten days ago; should be in the mix again and he's respected in change of headgear.

runners.comment: Infrequent winner but conditions should be fine and he's not ruled out back on the Flat
runners.name: Gemini Man
runners.spotlight: Just one win from 23 starts on the Flat and he's 1-13 over hurdles; has been up and down over jumps since his Hexham win last summer but he went close at Musselburgh on his penultimate run; conditions should be fine back in this sphere and could be dangerous if this sets up for his closing style; cheekpieces removed.

runners.comment: 0-11 but was fair fourth at Lingfield (1m2f) last time and he's in the mix back on Tapeta
runners.name: Grand Harbour
runners.spotlight: 11-race maiden but he ran well for a long way when fourth of eight in a Lingfield handicap (1m2f, Polytrack) last time; had the run of that race but he's well drawn back on Tapeta and could give it another good shot.

runners.comment: Has struggled in all five runs including a classified event over C&D ten days ago
runners.name: Keeper Of Secrets
runners.spotlight: Tailed off in four runs for Rebecca Menzies before a well-held eighth over C&D (classified event) on recent stable debut; finished behind some of today's rivals in that race and he makes no appeal.

runners.comment: 21-race maiden who has been well held in last five runs; others preferred
runners.name: Millbuie
runners.owner: N J Dalgarno & W R Ellis
runners.spotlight: 21-race maiden who has been beaten 8l or more at a variety of trips in his last five runs; now returns to a classified event but this looks tough on the figures and others are preferred.

runners.breeder: Mrs S M Rogers & Sir Thomas Pilkington
runners.comment: Off the mark at Lingfield last month but he was disappointing there ten days later
runners.name: Myna
runners.spotlight: Off the mark at the 17th attempt when landing a classified event at Lingfield (1m2f, AW) last month;  interesting on that form but he was disappointing after a slow start on his return visit ten days later; needs to bounce back and he still has something to prove on Tapeta; hood reapplied.

runners.comment: Unplaced in all ten starts and she needs a transformation with blinkers added
runners.name: Resilient Lady
runners.spotlight: Unplaced in all ten starts and she's been well held over 7f, 1m and 1m4f in her three runs this winter; has plenty to prove and she needs a transformation with blinkers added.

runners.comment: Sole win was in 2024 and this looks a tough task at the weights; opposable
runners.name: Scarfo
runners.spotlight: Sole win from 28 starts was in July 2024; wasn't beaten too far at a big price on his reappearance here (8.6f) last month but this looks another tough task on the figures and others are preferred.

20:30.race_name: Win £250,000 With BetMGM's Golden Goals Handicap

runners.comment: Clear ability over 7f; well held in two 1m handicaps; up in trip with hood left off
runners.name: Attention Seeker
runners.spotlight: Close second in 7f Brighton maiden on second start; faded over 1m on handicap debut in October and finished last of seven on yard debut at Newcastle (1m, AW; first since wind surgery) recently; up again in trip with hood left off (worn last four starts) and has something to prove.

runners.comment: Minor form when qualifying and found little on recent handicap debut over 1m; up in trip
runners.name: Berkshire Schmokin
runners.owner: Berkshire Parts & Panels Ltd No1 Fanclub
runners.spotlight: Beat a total of three rivals in qualifying runs at 7f and 1m; went off 11-4 for handicap debut at Chelmsford (1m) this month where he raced freely and ran green before finishing nearly 7l behind the winner; may come on for the run but judgement suspended up in trip.

runners.comment: Well held in sole handicap as 2yo; seems to act on Polytrack; Tapeta debut after break
runners.name: Sweet Love
runners.spotlight: Seven runs as 2yo; well held in her sole handicap, over 7f at Musselburgh, but soft ground probably didn't help; acts well enough on Polytrack and interesting to see what the market says on Tapeta debut.

runners.comment: Some maiden promise over 1m but soundly beaten in two handicaps since, including over C&D
runners.name: Angry Ant
runners.spotlight: Best effort when beaten about 3l at Kempton (1m) in January but soundly beaten in two handicaps since, including over C&D; has much to prove.

runners.comment: Some promise at 1m on Tapeta; bred to improve for new trip now handicapping
runners.name: Darn Hot Dame
runners.spotlight: Quite promising fourth of eight in a 1m Southwell novice on second start, when not too far behind a subsequent winner; never threatened at Kempton since but she's bred to come into her own over this longer trip (if not further) and may well do better now handicapping.

runners.comment: Came from way back over 1m here latest; well worth a go over new trip; can be involved
runners.name: Akrivos
runners.spotlight: No great progress for handicaps at about 1m but he did come from a long way back to take a late fourth here recently behind a subsequent winner and now looks well worth a go over this extra distance; can be involved.

runners.breeder: Moyns Park Estate And Stud Ltd
runners.comment: Kept on well on handicap debut over 1m; bred to improve for new trip; of interest
runners.name: Montu
runners.spotlight: Beaten 11l+ in first three runs at up to 7f and he lacked the pace to make an impact in a recent 1m handicap at Kempton; however, he did keep persevering and this new trip should suit on pedigree; of interest.

runners.comment: Close up on final 2yo start (turf) but yet to shine on AW for new yard; new trip
runners.name: Shes Got The Blues
runners.spotlight: Finished close up on final 2yo start (1m, good to soft) but she hasn't shone on AW for new yard and has a stamina query over new trip.

runners.breeder: W H R John And Partners
runners.comment: Dead-heated over 7f in December; way back upped to 1m2f since; trip query; headgear on
runners.name: Lope Harswell
runners.spotlight: Has been handicapping since September, getting off the mark when dead-heating over 7f at Newcastle in December; never involved and way back over 1m2f there since and needs to show this is her trip; cheekpieces on.
